problem.title: Videos showing only one cartoon character repeatedly
problem.description: All training videos have same single cartoon character with only text changing. Tools like Stable Diffusion were installed but not being used.
problem.user_complaint: oh ikko cartoon bana ke sirf text te likhda hai gurdwara seva ,langer ja kujh hor video sirf ohi cartoon hai jo tools install ketey oh vartey hi nahi ja rahey?
problem.root_cause: realistic_renderer.py only has one hardcoded character (Punjabi man with turban). No variety in characters despite having AI tools.

solution_required.main_goal: Create diverse characters in every video - men, women, kids, elderly
requirements: Multiple character types (8+): men, women, kids, elderly, youth
Different appearances: skin tones, clothing colors, styles
Gender variety: male and female characters
Age variety: kids, youth, adults, elderly
Traditional Punjabi look: turbans, suits, kurtas
Random selection per video for variety

files_to_modify.changes: Add diverse character system with 8+ character templates

rahbar_instructions.step_1: Read diverse_character_generator.py to understand character system
rahbar_instructions.step_2: Modify realistic_renderer.py to use diverse characters
rahbar_instructions.step_3: Ensure random character selection per video
rahbar_instructions.step_4: Test with 3 videos to verify variety
rahbar_instructions.step_5: Open generated videos to visually confirm diversity
